AgentChatApiKeyChoice.description: The user's answer: the API key (billed to the API), or the login.

AgentChatApiKeyQuestion.description: The pane's environment has an Anthropic API key that Claude Code has no answer for yet (the TUI asks once: use it, or the subscription login). Claude does not start in conversation mode until the user answers; the answer is filed where Claude Code keeps it, so the terminal asks no more.

AgentChatAsleep.description: The headless process was stopped after the session sat idle (the `conversation.idle_stop_minutes` setting): the next message wakes it.

steer.description: A message written mid-turn steers it.

questions.description: Structured questions to the user (cards with choices).

rewind.description: `code`: the code is restored too, not only the conversation.

promptSuggestions.description: The agent guesses the next message (the next-prompt chip).

shellLines.description: `!` lines: run by Roamgate and read by the agent with the next message ("prelude"), run by the agent itself ("native"), or not offered.

backgroundTasks.description: Work that outlives a turn is tracked (/tasks, the background chip).

images.description: Images go inline ("base64") or as the uploaded file's host path.

slashCommands.description: Which slash command palette the composer offers.

models.description: The running agent's model is listed and switched (/model).

mcp.description: The running agent's MCP servers are listed and acted on (/mcp).

backgroundTools.description: A running command or subagent can be moved to the background (Ctrl+B), and a background task stopped. Absent from older servers.

AgentChatCapabilities.description: What a conversation's agent can do; the chat hides what it cannot.

text.description: The block's full text, or a tool call's input as JSON.

command_output.description: The text is what a command run in Claude Code itself printed: the uuid of the transcript record that has it.

AgentChatEvent.description: Events pushed to the browsers subscribed to a pane, as `{event: "agent_chat.<type>", data}` in a connection envelope. Text blocks are keyed by API message id and block index, which history entries carry too (`message_id`, `block_index`); tools by their tool_use id.

text.description: The block's full text, or a tool call's input as JSON.

command_output.description: The text is what a command run in Claude Code itself printed: the uuid of the transcript record that has it.

AgentChatHandoffPhase.description: Where a switch to another agent is (`agent_chat.switch_agent`): the outgoing agent being stopped, stopped and recorded, the incoming one being given the history. One agent writes at a time.

suspended.description: Handed back stopped (the chat's Ctrl+Z): the pane's shell has its prompt, and `fg` there brings the conversation back.

waiting.description: Refused for now, not for good: Claude's background work (a shell, a monitor) would stop with it. A switch asked "when idle" waits on.

writer.description: Refused because another Claude runs the session in another pane: which, so the user can go there or, when it is idle, have it quit (`quit_writer` on the next switch).

AgentChatHandoverResult.description: A refused or accepted handover, with the reason when refused.

AgentChatInterrupted.description: A turn cut short before its end: by a Roamgate restart, or by the headless process exiting (a crash, a kill, an SSH connection lost). What Claude Code had written stays in the transcript; the rest is gone.

agent.description: The agent conversation mode drives here; absent: claude.

work_session_id.description: The conversation's work session, kept across agent switches.

handoff_phase.description: While the conversation moves to another agent.

terminal_pid.description: The interactive claude's pid while it is being stopped.

headless_pid.description: The headless claude's pid while it runs (local connections).

headless_session_ids.description: The session ids headless processes were resumed with (their argv), newest last: after /clear a process still names the old one. A probe looks for any of them before another writer starts.

terminal_args.description: The flags the pane's claude ran with (--model, --permission-mode...): handing back resumes the session with them.

agent_terminal_args.description: Each other agent's terminal flags, kept while the conversation runs on another agent (`agent_chat.switch_agent`): back on that agent, they are its `terminal_args` again.

queue.description: Roamgate's queue of messages typed while a turn ran, kept here while no process holds it (the connection was replaced, Roamgate restarted).

turn_started_at.description: When the turn that runs was written to the headless process: a restart, or the process exiting, while this is set cut the turn short.

interrupted.description: The last turn was cut short; cleared by the next turn or a dismiss.

asleep_at.description: Since when its headless process is stopped for being idle (idle stop): the holder keeps the pane, and the next message starts it again.

resume.description: Where the latest child's lines were handled to, with the state they left the conversation in: the next runtime reads only what follows.

holder.description: The pane holder that runs the headless claude: how far Roamgate read its log, and the commands it had not confirmed yet. A runtime after this one reads on from there.

reason.description: Why, as Roamgate last saw it.

AgentChatLost.description: Roamgate cannot read the conversation process the pane holder runs (its log does not come through, say): nothing is delivered until it is recovered, which ends that process and starts a new one on the session.

AgentChatMcpAction.description: What can be asked of an MCP server as it is now.

target.description: Its host or command: never its arguments, headers or environment.

version.description: What it calls itself once connected ("github 1.2.0").

toolCount.description: How many tools it has, when the agent gives no list.

AgentChatMcpServer.description: An MCP server of the session, as /mcp lists it.

url.description: The page to open; null: the agent needed no sign-in after all.

redirects.description: The page redirects back to the agent's machine: the address it lands on can be pasted (finish-sign-in) where that machine is out of reach.

AgentChatMcpSignIn.description: How a sign-in goes on once the agent has started it.

AgentChatMcpStatus.description: What an MCP server of the session is doing (/mcp).

value.description: What is asked for: an alias ("sonnet"), "default", or a model id.

resolved.description: The model id the value stands for, when the agent says.

disabled.description: Listed, but not to be picked (the agent says why in description).

AgentChatModel.description: A model /model offers, as its picker lists it.

model.description: The model the agent runs from then on, as it names it.

AgentChatModelNotice.description: What the chat says of the last /model, after its last entry.

current.description: The model the session runs, as the agent names it; null: not known.

chosen.description: The value last picked for it, kept for its next start; null: none.

source.description: Where the list came from: the running agent, the profile's endpoint, or both together.

error.description: The profile's list could not be read.

AgentChatModels.description: The models /model offers in conversation mode (agent_chat.models).

AgentChatNextPrompt.description: Claude Code's predicted next user message. Never sent by itself.

workspace_label.description: As Herdr names them; a browser that knows the pane names it itself.

status.description: What Herdr says it does: idle (at its prompt, no turn running), working (a turn or a background task), blocked (it waits for an answer in its terminal), or unknown.

quit_refusal.description: Why it did not quit when the user asked it to, if they did.

AgentChatOtherWriter.description: Another Claude on the same session, in another pane of the pane's Herdr: a switch to conversation mode waits until it is gone, as two writers would mix their turns in one transcript. Only an idle one may be asked to quit.

AgentChatOwner.description: Who writes to the session now.

AgentChatPhase.description: Where a session is in its life: owned by the terminal, being handed to conversation mode (the TUI is exiting), owned by conversation mode, or being handed back (the headless process is exiting).

images.description: Upload paths of the images sent with it.

AgentChatRewindCheck.description: What a rewind to before a message could do to the code, known before the user picks, from the transcript: "none" when the turns after it edited no file with Claude's file tools, "no_checkpoint" when they did (`files`) but Claude Code kept no checkpoint for the message, "restorable" when it did, "unknown" when the transcript does not tell.

AgentChatRewindMode.description: What a rewind restores: as Claude Code's /rewind offers it.

AgentChatRewindResult.description: A rewind in conversation mode. `prefill` is the message rewound to, for the chat's box; `files` the files the code restore changed. `code`, when the code was asked for: "restored", or "none" when the turns rewound changed no file Claude Code can restore (the conversation alone was cut). Refused with `no_checkpoint`: files were edited (`files`, when known), but Claude Code kept no checkpoint of them (edits from before checkpoints were on); nothing was rewound, and the conversation alone still can be.

truncated.description: Output past the cap was left out (Claude reads the cap only).

exit_code.description: Null while it runs, and when it was stopped or could not start.

cwd.description: The directory it runs in, on the pane's host.

error.description: Why it could not start or finish.

delivered.description: Sent to Claude with a message: the transcript shows it from now on. The browser keeps the last few sent, for what the transcript does not keep of them (how they ended).

AgentChatShell.description: A `!` line run from the chat on the pane's host, as Claude Code's bash mode: its output so far, each stream cut at BASH_OUTPUT_LIMIT.

agent.description: The agent conversation mode drives in the pane, and what it can do (see chatCapabilities); sent while a lease exists. An older server sends neither: claude.

work_session_id.description: The conversation's work session, kept across agent switches.

handoff_phase.description: While the conversation moves to another agent.

tools_running.description: A tool call is running: speech steers the turn instead of stopping it.

running_tools.description: The tool calls that run, by tool_use id; absent from older servers.

activity.description: What it is doing: a tool's name, "thinking", "compacting".

interrupted.description: The last turn was cut short, until the next one starts.

lost.description: The conversation process cannot be read: Recover starts a new one.

stuck.description: The turn seems to hang: Interrupt, or Restart Claude.

asleep.description: Its process is stopped while idle; the next message wakes it.

api_key_question.description: Claude waits to start until the user says which account pays.

shells.description: `!` lines run from the chat that Claude has not read yet: running, or done and waiting for the next message, which takes them to Claude.

streamed.description: On a subscription only: the reply text already streamed of the turn that runs, so a browser that comes in the middle of it (a reload) draws all of it, not just what streams after.

next_prompt.description: What Claude Code guesses the user will say next, after its last turn (prompt suggestions on); gone once another turn starts.

model_notice.description: What the last /model did, until the next message goes.

AgentChatStatus.description: What the headless process is doing.

done.description: Its complete text came (the CLI's assistant message).

AgentChatStreamedText.description: A text block of the running turn, as streamed so far.

AgentChatSwitchResult.description: What `agent_chat.switch_agent` did: the conversation now runs on `agent`, in the same work session; `unchanged` when it already did. `from_seq`..`through_seq`: the events the agent was given; `reused_session`: its earlier native session was resumed.

AgentChatVoiceAction.description: What a spoken message did while Claude was working (the barge-in mix).

ClaudeStartMode.description: Where a `claude` started by hand in a Herdr pane goes: it stays in the terminal, or conversation mode takes it as soon as it is up.

ConversationAgent.description: The agents conversation mode drives (Herdr's agent names): each has a driver on the server, a headless protocol and its terminal side.
